implementation: Netronome SSL Inspector Appliance model SI-10000
description: The SSL Inspector is a transparent SSL proxy designed to detect SSL traffic and then under policy control to "inspect" the traffic. Inspection involves decrypting and re-encrypting the traffic to gain access to the clear text data and then passing this data to an associated security appliance that needs to see decrypted traffic.

oes.name: Linux x86_64 on SI-10000 has two Intel E5620 quad core CPUs and 24GB of memory.
